pool.text: Poet governor Su Shi constructed a causeway across West Lake using mud.
Yuefei Temple was constructed near the West Lake to commemorate Yue Fei.
Advancing Mongol armies of Kublai Khan besieged and captured the city.
Moroccan traveler Ibn Battuta visited Hangzhou and noted its charm.
The Taiping Heavenly Kingdom occupied Hangzhou during the nineteenth century.
The city was occupied by Japan during the mid-twentieth century.
The People's Liberation Army entered Hangzhou under Chinese Communist Party control.
Hangzhou hosted a series of labor unrest and factional fighting.
Hangzhou Hi-Tech Industrial Development Zone was set up with official approval.
Hangzhou Economic and Technological Development Zone was established and approved.
Binjiang District was officially established on December eleventh.
Hangzhou Export Processing Zone was established upon approval of the council.
Xiaoshan and Yuhang were reorganized as two distinct administrative districts.
The construction of the Hangzhou Metro started in March.
The China Railway High-Speed service was officially inaugurated in October.
Hangzhou Metro Line 1 opened on November twenty-fourth.
The Hangzhou Tourism Commission started an online campaign via Facebook.
The Grand Canal was designated a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Hangzhou hosted the eleventh G20 summit in China.
The city undertook strong curfew measures owing to the coronavirus outbreak.
